cohort_notes: Useful traces are usually boring to read and valuable to compare: tool choice, recovery, and outcome matter more than a polished transcript.
The public board is opt-in identity only. Trace submission still works without publishing a handle.
If your accepted credit stalls at zero, try a metadata-only trace before escalating to the operator.
